history-gate-plan.json.hypothesis: Track a conservative Bloom set of all pre/post collision center cells. Bloom collisions, truncation and old starts may only cause extra work, never skipped candidates. Copy the set when cloning caches.

packed-normals-plan.json.hypothesis: Build contiguous query entries with copied immutable normals, so branchless direction filtering avoids pointer-chasing each line record. Compare stepping and broad engine work; report larger query buffers explicitly.

developmentInterpretation.outline_collide: Outlining collision functions preserved parity but slowed isolated stepping; rejected.
developmentInterpretation.compact_branched: Direct writes retaining the direction branch improved the initial stepping diagnostic. Branchless compaction was selected for further qualification; these separate exploratory estimates do not establish a head-to-head difference.
developmentInterpretation.compact_branchless: Improved initial stepping, replay and branch diagnostics with unchanged measured memory high-water. Refined with safety comments and storage-edge tests, then frozen as compact_final.
developmentInterpretation.no_history_events: Suppressing unused event writes during history replay preserved parity but showed no reliable broad-workload benefit; not adopted.
developmentInterpretation.history_gate: A conservative visited-cell Bloom filter let disjoint edits skip history replay. Exact diagnostic parity passed, but stepping and broad workloads slowed. Rejected; no history-gate code was adopted.
developmentInterpretation.packed_normals: Contiguous query normals plus branchless compaction improved against baseline, without evidence of an additional gain over the simpler branchless candidate. Not selected. Actual query buffers are larger even though measured linear-memory high-water pages are unchanged.
